description: Always-on Black Sapphire (Paradise) tower population for Clean-Slate Night City. Compiled by tools/build-clean-slate.py into mod\neon_ascendancy\bsc_tower_population.questphase and wired off the ascendancy.questphase fact fan-out (NOT behind na_dev_venue_probe). Activates only the location/open-world communities vanilla uses, with the default/idle/guard entry phases so nothing depends on a scene. Source: docs/research/factions/barghest.md location catalog plus the exact vanilla entry/phase pairs from q303_06_paradise / q303_06b_paradise_technical / q303_07_finale.

keep_alive_pause.why: Never set; keeps the tower communities spawned for the whole save.
